variable.name: rfftlr
variable.definition: Value of eff. federal funds rate given by the Taylor rule with unemployment gap
variable.description: RFFTLR is a version of the Taylor Rule. According to the equation, the nominal funds rate equals the sum of the equilibrium real funds rate as perceived by policymakers (RSTAR) and a four-quarter moving average of actual inflation. This value is then adjusted in response to deviations of actual inflation from the target rate of inflation (PITARG) and deviations of the unemployment rate from the natural rate of unemployment.

standard_equation.eviews_equation: rfftlr - rfftlr_aerr = rstar + y_rfftlr(1) * pitarg + y_rfftlr(2) * ( ( picxfe + picxfe(-1) + picxfe(-2) + picxfe(-3)) ) + y_rfftlr(3) * (lurnat + deuc * leuc - lur)
standard_equation.python_equation: rfftlr - rfftlr_aerr = rstar + y_rfftlr_1 * pitarg + y_rfftlr_2 * ( ( picxfe + picxfe(-1) + picxfe(-2) + picxfe(-3)) ) + y_rfftlr_3 * (lurnat + deuc * leuc - lur)
